name: Hatsukare☆Ren'ai Debut Sengen!
original_name: はつカレっ☆恋愛デビュー宣言!
source:
The start of April, today is the beginning of my second year in high school. During my first year, I didn’t join any clubs, made a decent effort with my studies, and somehow managed to get by the year being swept away by my surroundings in a daze. But I’m definitely saying no to spending a mediocre high school life until graduation. I want to be like everyone else, joining clubs, doing part-time jobs, and having hobbies. I want to challenge myself to find something that I can give my all to. And most importantly…. I want to fall in love!

I heard this from my friend, and it piqued my interest, the jinx that circled around Haruhino High School. If you two watch the fireworks from the ‘Asumigaoka’ that overlooks the street below, and share a kiss together, then your love will last forever.

Can I fulfill this with the person I love too?

[From [url=http://konnistique.tumblr.com/post/43261542109/furyu-otome-game-release-april]konnistique's Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
四月初，今天是我高二的開學日。第一年，我沒有加入任何社團，學習也很努力，不知怎麼的，就這樣在周圍的環境中迷迷糊糊地度過了這一年。但我絕對不會在畢業前度過平庸的高中生活。我想像其他人一樣，加入社團、去打工，擁有自己的愛好。我想挑戰自己，找到一些我可以全力以赴的事情。最重要的是……我想談戀愛！

我從朋友那裡聽到了這句話，這激起了我的興趣，這是圍繞著春日野高中的傳說。如果你們兩人在俯瞰街道的「阿斯之丘」上看煙火，並一起親吻，那麼你們的愛情就會天長地久。

我也可以和我愛的人一起實現這一點嗎？
